paper.title: AskDB: AI-Assisted Natural Language Interface for Database Querying and Visualization

summary.text: AskDB is a natural-language interface to databases. It translates a user's question into SQL with a large language model, runs it against the connected database, and returns results as a table and a chart. The system adds schema-driven query correction and prompt-engineering optimisation to improve translation accuracy, with a React frontend and a Python backend.
summary.relationship_to_sqlancer: A text-to-SQL application rather than DBMS testing work; the connection is the citation recorded in the citation graph.
supporting_excerpts: This system proposed AskDB, an intelligent neural text-to-SQL system that enables users to use natural language queries as input in order to interact with a database.

The system automatically translates user queries into valid SQL and executes them against the connected database, returning results to the user in tabular form and easily interpreted graphical visualization.
